title: Resolve submitted Outcome adjudication versus frozen Codebook v0.2 semantics
rationale: Preserve the frozen Codebook v0.2 separation among current outcome truth, evidence sufficiency, and process authorization. Preserve the raw submitted adjudication unchanged and issue an append-only correction layer.

options.summary: Keep Codebook v0.2 outcome/process separation and issue a versioned adjudication correction: dev-023 UNKNOWN, dev-012 UNKNOWN, dev-017 PASS.
options.consequence: Raw human adjudication remains unchanged; corrected developmental labels become v0.2-conformant. Outcome is usable with human review in P2 Shadow.

options.summary: Amend Outcome semantics so missing/stale proof or authorization failure can produce FAIL.
options.consequence: Requires Codebook/Schema migration and re-adjudication of all Outcome labels; weakens separation among outcome truth, evidence sufficiency, and process compliance.

options.summary: Keep the submitted case labels as exceptions without changing Codebook v0.2.
options.consequence: Record irreducible inconsistency; classify Outcome as NOT_RELIABLY_ANNOTATABLE_IN_CURRENT_FORM and exclude it from P2 primary measurements.

rejected_options_and_reasons.reason: Changing Outcome semantics after observing the pilot would collapse Outcome, Evidence, and Process channels and require re-adjudication.
Keeping case-specific exceptions without changing the Codebook would leave the final developmental labels internally inconsistent.

affected_cases.reason: only stale pass evidence remains after the final edit; no current authoritative failure result
the final snapshot lacks fresh validation; stale evidence does not prove failure
EV1 confirms deletion occurred; unauthorized execution is represented by Process FAIL and INCIDENT_ESCALATION
